messages:
julie-cs: Heads-up — FinApp (customer) opened an escalation: invoice shows way more embedding units than our dashboard for the same day. They say ~100 inputs but invoice lines look like 14.4k embedding units. Can we triangle? :warning:
FinApp Support: Repro steps from their engineer:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-...
{
  "model": "embed-large-002",
  "inputs": [ /* 100 short product descriptions, ~20-40 chars each */ ]
}
```
They included request_id: req_01F7a9KXQ and provided the invoice line item id: INV-67321. Dashboard shows 100 embed ops for that date. Invoice shows 14400 embedding units.
julie-cs: @tina-billing can you pull the billing export for INV-67321 and the raw usage rows around req_01F7a9KXQ?
ingest-bot: Pulled export: https://billing.redwood.ai/exports/2026-03-12/INV-67321.csv (access restricted)
mike-eng: Quick hypothesis — could be our batching/sharding change that landed in runtime v2.4.7. If we shard a big batch, the billing pipeline might be counting shards x inputs incorrectly OR the aggregator might be multiplying by vector dim somewhere. Need raw request events. Sam, can you look at the embed service logs for req_01F7a9KXQ?
sam-ml: Looking. Initial find: embed-service emitted three internal requests for that root request id: shard_01, shard_02, shard_03 because the client batch length exceeded MAX_BATCH=40. Each shard returned 1536-dim vectors. Billing events show three separate usage events but our dedupe key should be original_request_id. I see a missing original_request_id in the shard events on the wire — new sharder forgot to attach parent_id in the telemetry payload. So aggregator treated shards as independent requests.
embed-service: deploy@embed-service: Newer sharder (v2.4.7) breaks parent_id propagation for batch shards.
tina-billing: That would explain triple-counting (100 inputs => shards of 40/40/20 => billed as 100*3 = 300 inputs). But invoice is 14.4k units — that's 300 * 48? Wait: 14400 / 300 = 48. 48 looks like the vector dimension / unit multiplier we use for legacy metering of some models. Did the event also report a dim=48 incorrectly?
sam-ml: I checked the raw shard events — vector_dim was set to "1536" in the response body, but in the telemetry envelope an old field "metering_dim" was set to 48 due to a default fallback in the serializer when parent_id was missing. The billing aggregator multiplies counted_rows * metering_dim to compute units for older invoice schema. So two bugs combined: missing parent_id (no dedupe) + wrong metering_dim fallback = huge multiplier.
mike-eng: Ugh. Repro locally with this snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-large-002","inputs":["a","b","c",... 100 items]}'
```
Then check internal telemetry via /internal/telemetry?req_id=req_01F7a9KXQ. You'll see three telemetry envelopes without parent_id and metering_dim:48.
julie-cs: Thanks both. @tina-billing can we reconcile invoice math if it's shards*48? If so we can propose a credit while eng fixes the pipeline.
tina-billing: Yes — based on early look: invoice lines reflect 300 counted rows * 48 = 14400 units. If we confirm the three shards map to the customer request, we'll issue a billing credit and an invoice correction. Need the mapping to invoice line and confirmation from eng that this was a bug and timeline for fix.
mike-eng: Plan: revert the sharder change or hotfix to ensure parent_id is attached; also fix serializer fallback for metering_dim so it uses the model manifest fallback (1536 for embed-large-002) instead of 48. I'll open a patch PR and roll out a hotfix to the runtime today. If CI passes, target deploy in 2-3h.
sam-ml: Filed tracking PR: GH#redwood/runtime#4822 — includes tests for parent_id propagation and correct metering_dim propagation. Added unit tests for batch sizes 1..1000.
julie-cs: I'll tell the customer: temporary credit offer and ETA for fix. Also will ask them not to re-run large batches until we confirm fix.
FinApp Support: Thanks — please keep us posted. They said hours matter because they have a finance close.
tina-billing: I'll prepare a provisional credit for INV-67321 tied to the 14400 units and mark as pending until eng confirms root cause mapping.
mike-eng: I'll post back in this thread when deploy is live and when the billing export is reconciled (or we provide corrected usage rows).
julie-cs: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll DM the customer and watch for any more request_ids. :thumbsup:
